intervals.label: conceptual design
intervals.note: Publication of the Near Detector Conceptual Design Report. No source consulted (checked 2026-09-16) gives a construction start date for the near detector.
intervals.quote: This report describes the conceptual design of the DUNE near detector

name: DUNE Near Detector
notes: Status "proposed" reflects the evidence available: the ND CDR (2021) is the latest near-detector design document consulted (checked 2026-09-16), and none of the sources consulted gives a construction milestone.

placements.note: Located on the Fermilab site just downstream of the neutrino source. No source consulted gives coordinates for a dedicated near-detector hall, so the Fermilab main-campus site is used.
placements.quote: a composite near detector (ND) installed just downstream of the neutrino source

target_medium.locator: ND CDR, §1.2 Overview of the Near Detector
target_medium.quote: a LArTPC constructed using ArgonCube technology ... consists of a high pressure gaseous argon TPC ... Currently two options are being explored for the inner tracker, one based on a combination of plastic scintillator cubes with TPCs and one based on straw-tubes
target_medium.value: liquid argon (ND-LAr) and high-pressure gaseous argon (ND-GAr), plus the SAND inner tracker (two options under study: plastic scintillator cubes with TPCs, or straw tubes)

description.quote: A critical component of the DUNE ND is a LArTPC constructed using ArgonCube technology. ... ND-LAr consists of 35 optically separated LArTPC modules
description.value: Modular liquid argon TPC (35 optically separated modules) based on ArgonCube technology, a critical component of the near detector

description.locator: ND CDR, §1.5 (TMS) and §2.1 (ND-GAr downstream of ND-LAr)
description.note: The ND CDR explicitly does not describe the TMS in detail.
description.quote: Immediately downstream of ND-LAr is the gaseous argon (GAr) component, ND-GAr, which serves ND-LAr as a muon spectrometer. ... a possible Day 1 detector in this location (Temporary Muon Spectrometer, TMS)
description.value: Possible Day-1 muon spectrometer (Temporary Muon Spectrometer, TMS) in the location of ND-GAr, immediately downstream of ND-LAr

description.quote: SAND consists of an inner tracker surrounded by an ECAL inside a large solenoidal magnet. ... The magnet and ECAL are repurposed from the KLOE detector
description.value: Magnetised on-axis beam monitor with an inner tracker and electromagnetic calorimeter inside a large solenoid, reusing the KLOE magnet and calorimeter

summary.plain: A set of smaller detectors on the Fermilab site, right where the neutrino beam is made. Measuring the beam before it travels lets scientists work out what changed by the time it reaches South Dakota.
summary.technical: Composite near detector just downstream of the LBNF target: ND-LAr (modular ArgonCube LArTPC), a downstream muon spectrometer (TMS on day one, later ND-GAr) that can move off axis for DUNE-PRISM, and SAND, a magnetised on-axis beam monitor reusing the KLOE solenoid and calorimeter.

technology.quote: The DUNE ND has three primary detector components and the capability for two of those components to move off the beam axis. ... The final component of the DUNE ND suite is a magnetized beam monitor called the System for on-Axis Neutrino Detection (SAND)
technology.value: composite near detector: a modular liquid argon TPC (ND-LAr), a muon spectrometer downstream of it, and a magnetised on-axis beam monitor (SAND)
